items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I don't know what happened to Caden, but oh, but that guy was rough.

ctx.x: I couldn't see that. It was rough. But they liked it. It's somewhat the better, you see? Yes, that's an Irish Channel for you, you see? That's why I said it's just the people. You've got to learn your people and give them satisfaction. Of course we played for them, but at the same time they were asking where was that trumpet playing. And come right before the band there too and ask why that fellow with the funny eye. They were. That was Joe on him. He got hit in the eye.
I don't know what happened to Caden, but oh, but that guy was rough.
He could play that instrument though. You could hear him by from here to the bridge over there.
